description.value: ASA Sushi (also branded as Asa Japanese Raw Bar & Kitchen) has been a fixture in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood since 1996, serving classic nigiri, sashimi, and rolls alongside its own creative Canadian-influenced house creations. All dishes are made to order with fresh ingredients, and the restaurant offers online ordering with in-store pickup, a practical option for cyclists who want a quick meal without a long wait.
